The Entra account the channel last wrote on a row, from the log

log_channel_entra_id.Rd

Item 11 of the 0.27.0 (decided on 2026-11-12): applied_entra_id is believed from the log only, as owned_by is (log_owner()). The value is the newest write of the field signed by an account of channel_account in the row's current life (log_of_record()), in the form of its door, register_entra_id_import(): details holding applied_entra_id = '<value>' and nothing else. The field is @READONLY on the form and written by an import as any other, so a value a referent imported is not the channel's and is passed over.

Usage

log_channel_entra_id(events, record, channel_account)

Arguments

events

The owners' log, as register_log() returns it.

record

The record id to look at.

channel_account

The REDCap usernames that hold the round's token, one or more. Not NULL: without them no value is believed.

Value

One identifier; "" when the channel never wrote one in the row's current life; NA_character_ when the log cannot say.

Details

Two writes make the answer unknown, the direction that neither checks nor writes anything for the row: a write of the field whose author is blank or missing, which could be the channel's, above the one believed; and a write of the channel's in another form, beside other fields, whose value cannot be told apart from theirs. A write of the channel's that leaves the field empty names nobody, and the one below it is read: it is the first half of a write the door makes twice, when the field already showed the value.
